rules: Anyone who orders leaves the flow at once.
The same person can re-enter after 7 days.
why: The code only appears in the third email. Shoppers who would buy anyway never see it.
All three land inside 25 hours, while the intent is fresh.
watch: One bad template tag can make every send skip without an error. Check send counts after each template edit.
